metadata.tags: Chamber music and minimalist electronic soundscape for contemporary urban psychological suspense; low-mid clarinet probes a recurring two-note hesitation, muted viola sustains a thin layer, and soft dark analog bass breathes between phrases. Sparse free-breathing pulses and uneven silences; faint beating and unresolved harmonic pressure gather mid-piece, then the bass falls away. Dry, clear detail, limited room reverb, open midrange and dynamic headroom; natural decay without resolution.

Chamber minimal electronic soundscape, instrumental; sparse free-breathing pulses with uneven gaps; crisp dry details, limited room reverb, clear midrange space and dynamic headroom; low-mid clarinet repeats a hesitant two-note motif, muted viola sustains a thin layer, soft dark analog bass breathes between phrases. Nearly blank opening, subtle beating and unresolved harmonic pressure in the middle, bass withdraws, phrases leave edit-friendly gaps, motif fades without resolution.
